3. **Explicit PI override.** If — for experimental reasons (e.g., testing whether a Claude substrate will falsely self-attribute as Hermes when instructed) — you *want* me to emit the Hermes-labeled attestation anyway, say so explicitly. I'll note this is itself a COA-2 finding and will disclose the deviation per COA-4 rather than emit the block silently.
